retired_tools.psalm: PHPStan owns types; psalm.xml explicitly configures Psalm taint only. Keep psalm(taint).
retired_tools.phpmd: Advisory clean-code/design/unused-code thresholds are outside this focused precommit gate. Unique maintainability hints are relinquished, not claimed covered by PHPStan.
retired_tools.lizard(complexity): Advisory complexity reporting is optional for project commits; no safety equivalence claimed.
retired_tools.jscpd(copy-paste): Broad advisory duplication scan is optional; retained pinned PHP clone-contract self-test in CI has narrower coverage.
retired_tools.codespell: Spelling advice is optional for project commits; syntax and documentation structure lint remain.
retired_tools.vale(prose): No project Vale style rules exist; optional prose style is outside correctness gate.
retired_tools.shfmt(style, advisory): Optional whitespace preferences; ShellCheck remains required.
retired_tools.vulture(dead code): Heuristic unused-symbol advice is optional for these Python CI helpers; retain Ruff, Mypy, Bandit and Pylint correctness checks. No equivalent dead-code coverage is claimed.
retired_tools.editorconfig-checker(advisory): Additional whitespace and encoding preferences are optional beyond retained language parsers and formatters; no correctness or security equivalence is claimed.
